# AiChat

AI chat on a Frame: a floating action button at the bottom right of the Page opens chat as a popup; from there it moves to the Frame's Panel or to full screen. It takes the Frame's props and adds the chat. - The button is the one way in. It hides while chat is open in the Panel or full screen. - The mode is remembered for the tab in sessionStorage (and an open Panel). - Under 768 the popup is shown full screen. - `variant="storybook"` is the Storybook docs' chat: clear, move to Panel and close only, with no full screen and no more menu. - The conversation is kept in memory and moves with the mode. There is no history, and no backend: `respond(text, history)` returns the reply, `history` being the turns before it as `{ role, text }`. A reply is text, or `{ text, sources }`: the pages or records it drew on list under it.

Also asked as: chat, assistant, chatbot, conversation.

**Import:** `import { AiChat } from '@/patterns';`

## Usage

AI chat is the one way to ask AI about the page in front of you. Pick the mode for the size of the ask.

| Mode | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Popup | The default. A quick ask that keeps the page in view. |
| Panel | Ongoing work beside the page. The Frame docks it, or opens it over the Page on a Blanket when there is no room. |
| Full screen | Long answers that need room. It covers the window. |

AI chat applies the six AI rules from the AI overview.

1. **One AI identity, unnamed.** The chat is called AI chat and carries the AI icon. It has no persona name or avatar.
2. **Every answer is marked.** Each reply is an AI message, which leads with the AI icon.
3. **Fallibility, once.** "AI can make mistakes. Check important info." sits under the prompt input, never on each message.
4. **Sources when it draws on data.** A reply that used records lists them under the message: `respond` returns `{ text, sources }` instead of text.
5. **People confirm actions.** The chat proposes changes; anything that changes data waits for the person's confirm.
6. **Feedback on every answer.** Each reply offers thumbs up and thumbs down, and `onFeedback` receives the reply with its rating. The rating stays on the reply as chat moves between modes.

### Storybook variant

`variant="storybook"` is the chat in the Storybook docs. The docs' floating button opens it through its AI agent action, so the chat's own button is left out with `launcher={false}`: the popup floats above the bottom right corner instead. `respond` may return `{ text, sources }`, and the sources list under the answer, opening in `linkTarget`. The docs' answerer calls a server-side function that answers from the design-system index and holds the credentials, so none reaches the browser; when it errors or is rate limited, the chat searches the site's pages and the component index instead and says so.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Call it AI chat, with the AI icon. | A persona name or an avatar. |
| Short starters that say what they ask: "Summarize this page". | Starters that are whole paragraphs. |
| Say "AI can make mistakes. Check important info." once, under the prompt input. | A warning on each message. |
| Name a source by its record: "Session notes, Oct 24". | Bare links or ids. |

## Best practices

### Use the popup for quick asks. {#use-the-popup-for-quick-asks}

A popup keeps the page in view. For ongoing work it covers the page and loses context: move it to the Panel.

### Use the Panel beside the page. {#use-the-panel-beside-the-page}

The Panel docks next to the work. For a quick ask it takes more room than the question needs.

### Use full screen for long work. {#use-full-screen-for-long-work}

Full screen gives long answers room. A docked Panel squeezes them.

### Mark every answer. {#mark-every-answer}

Do: Each reply is an AI message, led by the AI icon.
Don't: A reply in plain text reads as a person's.

### Say fallibility once. {#say-fallibility-once}

Do: One line, under the prompt input.
Don't: The line repeated under every reply turns into noise.

### List the sources an answer drew on. {#list-the-sources-an-answer-drew-on}

Do: The records the answer read, listed under it.
Don't: An answer from records with nothing to check it against.

## Accessibility

- The button is named by `title`, AI chat by default, and so is the Panel's complementary landmark unless `panelLabel` names it.
- The conversation is a log that announces new messages politely.
- Every reply carries one AI icon named "AI", so no answer reads as a person's to a screen reader.
- The thumbs are a group named "Rate this answer". A rated thumb is pressed, and a status line confirms the rating.
- The popup without the button (`launcher={false}`) takes focus in its prompt input on open, and Escape closes it.
- Full screen is a dialog named by `title`, and focus moves into it.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `variant` | enum | `'app'` | `app` carries every header control; `storybook` carries clear, move to Panel and close. |
| `defaultMode` | oneOf | `'popup'` | The mode a tab with nothing remembered starts in. |
| `defaultOpen` | bool | `false` | Whether chat starts open when the tab has nothing remembered. |
| `storageKey` | string | `variant === 'storybook' ? `${AI_CHAT_STORAGE_KEY}-storybook` : AI_CHAT_STORAGE_KEY` | The sessionStorage key the mode is kept under (the Storybook variant has its own); null keeps nothing. |
| `launcher` | bool | `true` | `false` leaves out the floating button: the popup then floats above the bottom right corner, and the host opens chat with `useAiChat().dispatch({ type: 'open' })`. |
| `linkTarget` | string | — | Where a reply's source links open, such as `_top` from inside a frame. |
| `onModeChange` | func | — | Called with the new mode whenever chat moves between popup, Panel and full screen. |
| `respond` | func | — | Returns the reply (or a promise of it) to a sent message: a string, or `{ text, sources: [{ title, href, type }] }`. Without it nothing answers. |
| `onFeedback` | func | — | Called with the answer and `{ rating }` (or `{ rating: 'down', comment }`) when a person rates it. Every answer offers thumbs. |
| `starters` | arrayOf (required) | — | `{ id, label, text }` prompts offered while the conversation is empty. |
| `title` | string | `'AI chat'` | The chat's name: the header title, the button's label and the Panel landmark. |
| `panelLabel` | string | — | Overrides the Panel landmark's name; defaults to `title`. |
| `children` | node | — | The Page content. |

## Variants

**`variant`** — `app` · `storybook`

**`defaultMode`** — `popup` · `panel` · `fullscreen`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
